column2: every sentence the phone shows lives in its copy deck, so German reaches all of it
the phone's packaged engine stays under its size ceiling and names no build machine
every writer that seals a mailbox password reads the sign-out stamp
every field the desktop engine logs is on the allowed list, so no secret or mail text reaches a log
the consent step states what a Cloud draft sends, with the counts read off the service
every word the web app draws comes from the catalogues, in both languages
a send record leaves by one door, so a send that may still finish is never sent twice
session cookies are read through the one reader that prefers the host-only __Host- spelling
a web session ends only on sign-out, a named refusal or the idle window, never on a fault
no catch block writes the signed-out verdict, which no behaviour test can reach
the session jar has one writer, so a late refresh never signs a browser into another account
a staff write reads its step-up token through one door, so the recency check cannot be skipped
every published account of what the desktop contacts names each kind of egress
no published file carries the billing plane's staff surface
